BETWEEN:-
 DHARMENDRA GOUD, S/O CHANNULAL GOUD, AGED
ABOUT 30 YEARS

, OCCUPATION: LABOUR, R/O GRAM  PATHRORA, THANA PATAN, DISTT. JABALPUR  (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI RAKESH KUMAR TIWARI - ADVOCATE)

AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THR. P.S. PATAN,
 DISTT. JABALPUR (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SMT. GEETA YADAV - PANEL LAWYER)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER

This is the first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.238/2023 dated 20.04.2023, registered at Police Station - Patan, District Jabalpur (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Section 376,
376(2)(n) of IPC.

Applicant is in detention since 21.04.2023.
2.
As per the prosecution story, in 2011 applicant placed a proposal before prosecutrix for entering into wedlock with him.
Thereafter, they developed liking for each other and in the meantime, they repeatedly established physical relations.
Last time, they established physical relation on 28.03.2023.
It is alleged that on 03.04.2023 applicant refused to marry with the prosecutrix.
FIR was registered.
After investigation, charge sheet has been filed.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant has not committed any offence.
He is innocent.
He has been falsely implicated.
Prosecutrix is pressurizing him for solemnizing marriage with her but applicant is not ready.
He never established physical relations with the prosecutrix.
An FIR has been lodged just to create pressure on the applicant.
Applicant and prosecutrix both are major.
Trial of the case will take considerable time.
Therefore, it is prayed that the applicant be released on bail pending the trial.
4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed the grant of bail to the applicant.
5. After investigation, charge sheet has been filed.

Therefore, having taking into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I am of the view that it is a case in which further pre trial detention of the applicant is not warranted.
Consequently, first bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

6. It is directed that applicant - Dharmendra Goud be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
7.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case o f bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
8. Certified copy as per rules.

(DINESH KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE Jasleen Dharmendra Goud vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/139108711/
